title: Split site::render into per-section helper functions
summary: Break the 333-line `render` in xtask/src/site.rs into small private section functions (header, start-here, states, counters, transitions, rationales, glossary, findings, next steps, claims, footer/wrapper) so every function is under 200 lines and the file stays under its limits. The HTML output must be byte-identical; the audience is the code-health check and maintainers.

defaults_applied.how: One focused refactor in a single file.
cargo test, clippy and fmt required as criteria.
Existing HTML-content tests are run to show unchanged output.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read xtask/src/site.rs (entry point build -> load -> render; render validates claims.json/pin.json/intro.json in order, then appends sections to one `body` String in a fixed order: header, Start here, States, Counters, Transitions, Why, Glossary, Limits, Next steps, Claims, About, footer) and its callers in xtask/src/main.rs and xtask/src/decisions.rs; read crates/athena-core/src/code_health.rs as the place code health measures per-function lines (limit 200) and production lines, so the property is measured by that check on render's own line count, not through a stand-in. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord/round-trip tests are not involved, and no refusal rule is added or tightened.
Goal: reduce render below 200 lines with no behavior change; helpers take `&mut String` body plus the needed study/known/github references and return Result<()>, preserving error order and messages.
Single file stays: 637 production lines is well under the 2000 file limit, so no module split is required.
No governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) needs to change; xtask has no library target so tests stay as unit tests in xtask/src/site.rs.
Environment: none needed; no CI, push or history read.

acceptance_criteria.text: In xtask/src/site.rs, `pub fn render(study: &Study) -> Result<String>` keeps its signature but is no longer than 200 lines; Grep of the file shows new private `fn` helpers (one per section) called from render, and no function in the file exceeds 200 lines.
The diff touches only xtask/src/site.rs; the `mod tests` block is not edited except possibly imports, and no test is deleted or weakened (git diff shows no removed #[test] functions).

Run `cargo test -p xtask`: all existing site tests pass unchanged, including the_real_study_renders_with_an_intro_and_glossary and the_page_cites_claim_ids_and_the_pinned_commit, showing the rendered HTML behavior is unchanged.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`; both exit clean.

Public items used by xtask/src/decisions.rs and main.rs (ATHENA_URL, CSS, DECISIONS_PAGE, escape, source_url, target_dir, default_out, check_out, load, build, render) keep their names, visibility and signatures.

out_of_scope: Changing HTML output, CSS, or error messages
Editing decisions.rs, main.rs or other files
Adding new tests beyond what the refactor needs
departures: Mechanical single-file refactor with strong existing tests; slightly higher pass probability than reference.
